d:
Haruno Momoko was an average woman. She's single, became on office lady shortly after graduating college, and is secretly a huge otaku for magical girl anime. One day, a strange squid-like creature named Ikaten appeared before her and promised to turn her into the type of hero she had admired since she was a young girl. Thus, Haruno turned into Clover Pink, a magical...BOY!? Thoroughly confused and aroused by her new body, Haruno has no time to think before she is recruited into a fight against invading alien forces. Lead by the Starfish King, Stella, they have come to steal feminine essence from human women for mysterious purposes. As the fights escalate, Haruno and Ikaten scout other women to join the fight. Clover Blue is Fuyumi Aoi, a mature beauty who is a caring mother and wife. Clover Yellow is Natsume Hinata, a strict teacher at an all girls private school who is inexperienced with men and more than a little sexually frustrated. Clover Orange is Akino Mikan, a college athlete that is admired by other women, but secretly desires to be more feminine. Together, these four women join together to become Magikal Clover!

A pet project of mine for a few years now, it all started when artist Mopan first drew a request I made in a /d/ thread: An office lady who turns into a magical femboy. TG stories involving boys turning into magical girls is pretty common, but I wanted to see the opposite. While the transformation into their magical femboy form is instant and reversible, the catch is the more often they turn into Clovers, the more their normal body gradually turns permanently male. Also, sorry, no MtF transformations here!

Big thanks to all the artists, especially Mopan who has helped develop this the most over the years.
